verdict.rationale: Bruno stores all collections as plain-text .bru files directly on the local filesystem, with no cloud account or lock-in, and natively integrates with Git for version control, letting users freely move or export their data at will; it also supports Postman import/export for portability. Community testimonials corroborate that collections are plain text files usable in Git, confirming open-format, no-lock-in data ownership. missing for 10: no explicit 'bulk export/leave' wizard or independent third-party audit of format openness beyond docs and community praise.
